scope: isolated browser integration; not production acceptance
astra_source_verification: 125 frontend source files matched GitHub blob hashes; presentation assets not hydrated

environment.identity: ephemeral synthetic Ethereum key, real nonce/signature/session handshake
environment.ui: actual ShmupResultsScreen and havnApi/rewardClaim sources; synthetic wallet/game React context
environment.dependencies: task-local npm packages after existing dependency tree lacked Windows Rollup binary

cases.name: failure_before_settlement
cases.fault: first reward request receives truncated JSON before reward route executes
cases.initial_ui: HavnAI coordinator unavailable; Retry claim visible
cases.final_ui: Fixture balance: 15; +15 HavnAI Credits; Retry claim absent

cases.name: response_lost_after_settlement
cases.fault: successful reward response replaced with truncated JSON after real route settlement
cases.initial_ui: HavnAI coordinator unavailable; Retry claim visible; fixture display balance 0
cases.action: clicked actual Retry claim button with original run state
cases.final_ui: Run already settled; Fixture balance: 15; Retry claim absent

limitations: Fault injection corrupts response JSON; it does not reset a TCP connection or test fetchWithRetry transport backoff.
Wallet/game React contexts are synthetic; real wallet extension interaction and full gameplay navigation were not tested.
Server clock was backdated only in the disposable fixture to avoid waiting for minimum run duration.
No production deployment, real wallet funds, purchased credits or external financial activity occurred.
Jira HAVN-55 explicitly requests live wallet/coordinator acceptance; isolated evidence does not silently waive that requirement.
